entries.session_name: Union Budget Special Live Trading Session
entries.reason: Saturday live trading session convened for Union Budget presentation per Circular Ref 172/2024 (Download Ref NSE/CMTR/65729) and NSE/MSD/66381. Market traded live 09:15-15:30. Authoritative calendar models this as a SPECIAL trading session. Standard daily Bhavcopy archive is unarchived/absent from local Bronze storage (local data gap); cited exception per AGENTS.md §6.3.

Official trading holiday for Diwali-Balipratipada per Circular Ref 170/2024 (Download Ref NSE/CMTR/65587). Exchange closed; zero trading took place. Erroneously listed as a regular session in baseline calendar.

Official trading holiday for Municipal Corporation Election in Maharashtra per Circular Ref 07/2026 (Download Ref NSE/CMTR/72260, issued 2026-01-12, in partial modification to NSE/CMTR/71775). Exchange closed; zero trading took place. Erroneously listed as a regular session in baseline calendar.

Regular trading day inferred per official 2026 holiday circular NSE/CMTR/71775 (which designated Saturday, March 21, 2026 as the Id-Ul-Fitr holiday).
